title: Finite-field linearity of the normalized completion comparison
statement: Fix a prime ell, an algebraic closure Omega of Q_ell, and a Noetherian scheme T of finite Krull dimension on which ell is invertible. Let stage_E be raw integral/rational comparison data [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum], and c a normalized completion scalar comparison [def-pur-inverse-scalar-coherence, lem-fd-completion-inverse-scalar-coherence] with those finite stages. Then each finite functor c.family.Phi_E is linear over the actual finite intermediate field E, with the existing scalar actions [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category] and [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients].

source.place: Final coefficient-category comparison sentence; finite linearity in comparison proof Steps 2 and 6; also smooth-purity transport proof Steps 2 and 4.

proof.text: Use the pure-tensor formula of stage_E and its additivity. Tensor induction proves semilinearity for every localized arrow: multiplication of the first tensor factor transports via pbcRationalCoefficientEquiv inverse composed with sfRationalCoefficientEquiv. The PBC localization field equivalence is pbcRationalCoefficientEquiv followed by Shrink.algEquiv, since both fix integral numerators and the uniformizer localization universal property determines them. The framework field equivalence is sfRationalCoefficientEquiv followed by the same Shrink.algEquiv. Therefore semilinearity is exactly E-linearity. Transfer it to c.family.Phi_E through the finite_functor equality. No triangle, common-stage Hom, inverse shift or inverse inclusion conclusion is asserted.

theorem fdCompletionFiniteStageLinear
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type w) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    [Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n)]
    [Fact (∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))]
    (stage : ∀ E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω, FdRationalStageComparison l Ω T E)
    (c : FdCompletionScalarComparison l Ω T stage) :
    ∀ E, (c.family.Φ E).Linear E.val
